artifact.title: Hiring trends in India

7e857efc-eb42-5ea2-a91f-9100ced4e143.content_text: A qualitative look at recruiting in 2026. Employers describe hiring as slower and more deliberate than before. Many report investing in structured interviews. Remote work remains common in technology roles.
